summary: Applying a potion of oil reaches an unported doapply arm before C light_cocktail can light it. C first handles swallowed, already-lit, and underwater branches; the selected unlit inventory potion is named, learned, and passed to begin_burn. The complete function also handles split stacks, billing, and re-merging a snuffed potion.

source.branch: For an unlit POT_OIL with the hero unswallowed and not underwater, light_cocktail optionally splits one potion from a stack, prints the source-specific light message, performs shop billing when unpaid at a costly spot, calls makeknown, then begin_burn.
